intent: HistoryEntryTest proves construction keeps session id, turn id, entry sequence, kind, content, token count and recorded timestamp; blank identifiers, a null kind, null content or a negative token count are rejected with IllegalArgumentException; the record exposes no mutator, so entries stay append-only.

methods.signature: HistoryEntry(String sessionId, String turnId, int entrySequence, String kind, String content, int tokenCount, Instant recordedAt)
methods.semantics: rejects blank sessionId/turnId, null kind/content/recordedAt, negative entrySequence or tokenCount
